title: Cuts for a minimum-inspection row
heading: Finding the Most Violated Cover Is a Knapsack of Its Own
cases: a line without which no plan reaches the floor, and which the LP point inspects only in part, is returned
a whole plan meeting the floor gets None, and a fractional point that under-uses a needed set gets that set
a set whose outside lines reach exactly the floor is not needed, since a plan can avoid it
the needed set returned is one the LP point inspects less than once in total, not one it inspects fully
